source.episode_title: Why Was Jesus Born in Bethlehem?
source.anchor_kjv: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
source.thread: About 700 years before Jesus, the prophet Micah named a small town, Bethlehem, as the birthplace of a promised King; a tax order sent Mary and Joseph there and Jesus was born (Luke 2:1-7); wise men came to Jerusalem asking where the King was, and Herod asked the Bible experts, who answered from the prophet: Bethlehem (Matthew 2:1-11); the Bible never says the experts went, the wise men went and found the child; Jesus came much farther, down from heaven (John 6:38), died for our sins and rose on the third day (1 Corinthians 15:3-4)
source.spoken_script: <!-- words v3 LOCKED 2026-11-15 (owner). Micah 5:2; Matthew 2:1-11; Luke 2:1-7; John 6:38; 1 Corinthians 15:3-4. Source prophecy/01_bethlehem/words/FINAL_WORDS_v3.md --> NARRATOR: The Bible experts knew where the King would be born. NARRATOR: Did they go? NARRATOR: About seven hundred years earlier, a prophet called Micah, a man who spoke God's message, named a small town: Bethlehem. NARRATOR: God promised a King from there. Micah called Him PROPHET: ruler in Israel. NARRATOR: Mary and Joseph lived far away. A tax order sent them to Bethlehem. There, God's promise came true: Jesus, the King, was born. NARRATOR: Wise men reached Jerusalem, asking where this King was. Herod, the king there, asked the experts. SCRIBE: In Bethlehem of Judaea. NARRATOR: Bethlehem was close by. (pause) The Bible never says the experts went. The wise men went, and found the child. NARRATOR: But Jesus came much farther. He came down from heaven. He died for our sins. On the third day, He rose from the dead. NARRATOR: Before anyone went to Him, He came to us.

platforms.title: Why Was Jesus Born in Bethlehem?
platforms.description:
Bible prophecy (Micah 5:2): Bethlehem was named 700 years before Jesus. The experts knew. Who went to see the King?

About 700 years before Jesus, the prophet Micah named a small town. Mary and Joseph reached it because of a tax order. Wise men came to Jerusalem asking where the King was, and Herod asked the Bible experts.

"But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting." (Micah 5:2, KJV)

"For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me." (John 6:38, KJV)

Read it yourself: Micah 5:2; Matthew 2:1-11; Luke 2:1-7; John 6:38; 1 Corinthians 15:3-4.

Before anyone went to Him, He came to us.

Find Jesus in the whole Bible, one story at a time. Subscribe to Salt and Light Kingdom. ✝

YouTube: @saltandlightkingdomorg (https://www.youtube.com/@saltandlightkingdomorg)

 quoted from the King James Version (KJV), public domain.

redteam:
VERDICT: REVISE
- All platforms, footer "Scripture quoted from the King James Version (KJV), public domain": the KJV is not public domain everywhere (UK Crown letters patent). Fix: "Scripture quotations: King James Version (KJV)."
- YouTube/Facebook line 1 "The experts knew. Who went to see the King?": repeats the on-screen question "Did they go?". Not dishonest, but pair it with a new angle. Fix: keep it, but do not add an answer; the film pays it off honestly (the Bible is silent on the experts).
- Check that no copy states the experts refused or stayed home: none does. Good. Keep it that way.
- YouTube Short body: "Mary and Joseph reached it because of a tax order" is correct to Luke 2:1-5. No change.
- TikTok/Instagram: hook is in line 1 and the Bethlehem question matches the search phrase. Instagram has 8 hashtags; fine for the platform, but #WiseMen and #ChristmasStory are broad. Optional trim.
- Quotes: Micah 5:2 and John 6:38 are verbatim KJV. No problems found.
- Scripture range: the film also touches 1 Corinthians 15:3-4 (died for our sins, third day). It is cited on every platform. Good.
